name: Google Calendar
author: hearth-team
description: Full CRUD on your Google Calendar via Google OAuth. action='list' (args: days_ahead default 7, calendar_id default 'primary') returns upcoming events WITH their event ids. action='create' books an event (args: summary, start_iso, end_iso required — RFC3339 e.g. 2026-09-02T11:00:00-04:00; description, attendees optional). action='update' moves/edits an event (args: event_id required — get it from action='list'; pass BOTH start_iso AND end_iso to move; summary/description optional). action='delete' removes an event (args: event_id required). Uses the calendar.events scope; one-click Connect in the gear panel.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client ID
vault_inputs.help: Usually blank — the Connect Google button uses your shared Google OAuth client (GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID), already set if Gmail or Calendar read-only is connected. Fill only to use a separate client for Calendar: Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth client ID (Web application) → add http://localhost:3000/oauth/callback as an Authorized redirect URI.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client secret
vault_inputs.help: Usually blank — only needed with a separate Calendar client. The 'Client secret' shown next to the Client ID in the Cloud Console Credentials list. Stored encrypted in your vault.

vault_inputs.label: Calendar refresh token (manual fallback)
vault_inputs.help: OPTIONAL — the 'Connect Google' button above does this in one click. Manual path: developers.google.com/oauthplayground → gear icon → 'Use your own OAuth credentials' → paste Client ID + secret → Step 1: tick https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events AND calendar.readonly → Authorize → Step 2: Exchange authorization code → copy the Refresh token here.
